summary.en: Cut and grind food into smaller pieces.
summary.zh: 切碎、磨碎食物。

detail.en:
Hard crowns cut, tear and grind food before swallowing. This is physical breakdown, not absorption. The model preserves the source teeth rather than adding absent wisdom teeth. [S4].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
坚硬的牙冠切断、撕开和磨碎食物。这是把食物弄碎，还不是吸收；模型保留源文件的牙齿，没有补画缺少的智齿。 [S4]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Work against the upper teeth to chew food.
summary.zh: 与上排牙齿配合咀嚼。

detail.en:
The lower jaw moves so opposing tooth surfaces break food into pieces. The small model movement stands for chewing; it is not a measured jaw movement. [S4].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
下颌移动，上下牙齿配合把食物弄碎。画面里的小幅运动代表咀嚼，并非实测的下颌动作。 [S4]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Mixes food with saliva and starts swallowing.
summary.zh: 拌匀食物和唾液，开始吞咽。

detail.en:
The tongue is muscular. It gathers chewed food into a soft lump and pushes it towards the throat; food then enters the gullet. [S4].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
舌由肌肉组成，把嚼过的食物聚成柔软的食团，再向喉咙推，随后进入食道。 [S4]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Release saliva that wets food and starts digestion.
summary.zh: 分泌唾液，润湿食物并开始消化。

detail.en:
Glands beside and beneath the mouth release saliva through small ducts. Saliva moistens food and begins the digestion of starch. Each side combines the source parotid, submandibular and sublingual glands. [S4].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
口旁和口底的腺体经小导管分泌唾液。唾液润湿食物，开始消化淀粉。每侧网格合并了源文件里的腮腺、下颌下腺和舌下腺。 [S4]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Passes swallowed food from mouth to gullet.
summary.zh: 让吞下的食物从口进入食道。

detail.en:
The food passage behind the mouth leads into the gullet. Swallowing coordinates the tongue and throat muscles and protects the airway. The airway is a different route. [S4].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
口后方的食物通道接着食道。吞咽时舌与咽部肌肉协调动作，保护气道；气道是另一条通路。 [S4]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Pushes swallowed food towards the stomach.
summary.zh: 把吞下的食物推向胃。

detail.en:
Waves of muscle contraction move a lump of food down the gullet. The gullet transports food; it does not add digestive juices. Oesophagus is its anatomical name. [S4].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
肌肉一波一波地收缩，把食团推下食道。食道负责运输，不加入消化液；英文解剖学名称是 oesophagus。 [S4]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Churns food and mixes it with digestive juice.
summary.zh: 搅拌食物，与消化液混合。

detail.en:
The stomach is a muscular chamber between the gullet and small intestine. Its lining releases acidic gastric juice, while contractions mix the contents into a soft paste. [S5].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
胃是食道和小肠之间的肌肉囊。内壁分泌酸性的胃液，肌肉收缩把内容物搅拌成糊状。 [S5]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Receives food from the stomach for more digestion.
summary.zh: 接收胃送来的食物，继续消化。

detail.en:
This beginning of the small intestine receives partly digested food. Further: bile and pancreatic juice enter here through ducts; food does not pass through the liver or pancreas. [S6,S7].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
这是小肠的开头，接收部分消化的食物。再进一步：胆汁和胰液经导管在这里流入；食物不经过肝或胰。 [S6,S7]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Continues digestion and absorbs digested food.
summary.zh: 继续消化，吸收消化后的食物。

detail.en:
Digested food passes through the small-intestine wall into the blood. These source coils are labelled jejunum, not the whole small intestine. The separately named ileum is absent from this model. [S6,S8].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
消化后的食物穿过小肠壁进入血液。源文件把这些盘曲标为空肠，并不是完整的小肠；模型没有单独命名的回肠。 [S6,S8]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Forms a blind side branch near the large intestine.
summary.zh: 是大肠起段附近的一条盲端支管。

detail.en:
Further: the appendix is a narrow side branch, not a station along the food route. Its wall contains lymphoid tissue. The adjoining caecum is not separately present in the source mesh. [S6].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
再进一步：阑尾是一条细小的侧支管，不是食物沿途经过的一站。管壁含有淋巴组织；相邻的盲肠没有单独的源网格。 [S6]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Absorbs water from the remaining contents.
summary.zh: 从剩余内容物中吸收水分。

detail.en:
The colon rises on the body’s right side. Water and some salts are absorbed as its contents move onwards. The small intestine has already absorbed most of the water. [S6,S8].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
结肠沿身体右侧上行。内容物前进时，水和一些矿物盐被吸收；此前小肠已经吸收了大部分水。 [S6,S8]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Carries the remaining contents across the abdomen.
summary.zh: 把剩余内容物横送过腹部。

detail.en:
The transverse colon crosses the upper abdomen. Together with the rising and descending sections it frames the small-intestine coils; it does not replace them as the main site of digestion. [S6].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
横结肠横过腹部上方，与上行、下行的部分一起围在小肠盘曲外侧；它并不是完成大部分消化的地方。 [S6]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Moves the remaining contents downwards.
summary.zh: 让剩余内容物向下移动。

detail.en:
The descending colon lies on the body’s left side. Water absorption and muscle movements continue as the contents pass towards the pelvic part of the large intestine. [S6].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
降结肠位于身体左侧。内容物向骨盆内的大肠部分移动时，吸水和肌肉运动仍在继续。 [S6]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Passes the remaining contents towards the outlet.
summary.zh: 把剩余内容物送向出口。

detail.en:
This bend normally leads into the rectum and then the anal canal. Those outlet meshes are absent here. The displayed source remains labelled sigmoid colon and is not relabelled as a rectum. [S6].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
这个弯段通常接着直肠和肛管。模型缺少这两处出口网格；显示的源结构仍称乙状结肠，不把它改称直肠。 [S6]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Makes bile that helps with fat digestion.
summary.zh: 制造帮助消化脂肪的胆汁。

detail.en:
Further: the liver produces bile. Bile travels through ducts towards the beginning of the small intestine; the gallbladder stores and concentrates it. Food stays in the digestive tube. [S7].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
再进一步：肝制造胆汁。胆汁经导管送向小肠开头，胆囊储存并浓缩胆汁。食物留在消化道里。 [S7]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Stores bile before it enters the small intestine.
summary.zh: 储存胆汁，再送入小肠。

detail.en:
Further: this small sac lies beneath the liver. It stores and concentrates bile, then releases it into the duct system. It does not make bile and does not receive food. [S7].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
再进一步：这个小囊在肝的下方，储存、浓缩胆汁，再把胆汁排入导管。它不制造胆汁，也不接收食物。 [S7]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Sends digestive juice into the small intestine.
summary.zh: 把消化液送入小肠。

detail.en:
Further: the pancreas lies behind the stomach and produces pancreatic juice. Its juice enters the duodenum through a duct. The thin flow line is schematic; there is no separately named pancreatic-duct mesh. [S7].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
再进一步：胰在胃的后面，制造胰液，再经导管送入十二指肠。细流线为示意，源文件没有单独命名的胰管网格。 [S7]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Carries bile towards the small intestine.
summary.zh: 把胆汁送向小肠。

detail.en:
Further: ducts connect the liver and gallbladder to the small intestine. The source mesh combines named bile ducts; the displayed flow explains direction rather than exact duct branching. [S7].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
再进一步：导管连接肝、胆囊与小肠。源网格合并了命名的胆管；流线说明流向，并非精确的导管分支。 [S7]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Pulls on bones to move the body.
summary.zh: 拉动骨骼，让身体运动。

detail.en:
Skeletal muscles contract and pull on bones. This selection of superficial muscles gives context for the digestive organs; it is not a complete muscular system. [S2].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
骨骼肌收缩、拉动骨骼。这里选取的浅层肌肉说明消化器官在身体中的位置，不是完整的肌肉系统。 [S2]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Helps change chest volume during breathing.
summary.zh: 改变胸腔容积，帮助呼吸。

detail.en:
This sheet of muscle separates chest and abdomen and helps breathing. It is context, not part of the digestive tube; the gullet passes through an opening in it. [S4].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
这片肌肉分隔胸腔和腹腔，并帮助呼吸。它是位置参照，不是消化道的一部分；食道经它的开口穿过。 [S4]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide with blood.
summary.zh: 与血液交换氧和二氧化碳。

detail.en:
The respiratory system brings air to the lungs, where oxygen enters blood and carbon dioxide leaves it. The mesh combines the lung lobes into a contextual pair. [S2,S9].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
呼吸系统把空气送到肺；氧进入血液，二氧化碳离开血液。网格把肺叶合并为用于参照的一对肺。 [S2,S9]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Carries air towards the lungs.
summary.zh: 把空气送向肺。

detail.en:
The windpipe belongs to the respiratory system. Food normally enters the gullet behind it; the swallowing illustration shows how the airway is protected. [S4].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
气管属于呼吸系统。食物正常进入它后方的食道；吞咽插图说明气道如何受到保护。 [S4]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Pumps blood through the circulatory system.
summary.zh: 泵送血液，在循环系统中流动。

detail.en:
Blood carries oxygen and absorbed nutrients around the body. The heart pumps that blood; it is not a place through which a swallowed meal travels. [S2,S9].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
血液把氧和吸收的营养运送到全身。心脏泵送血液，并不是吞下的一顿饭经过的地方。 [S2,S9]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Carry blood to and from the heart.
summary.zh: 输送进出心脏的血液。

detail.en:
This source selection includes the aorta and major veins. Fine intestinal blood vessels are omitted; the short nutrient branch is a schematic link to blood, not a traced vessel. [S9].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
这里选取了主动脉和大静脉。模型省略了细小的肠道血管；营养的短支流表示进入血液，不是描摹出来的真实血管。 [S9]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Supports the body and protects soft organs.
summary.zh: 支撑身体，保护柔软的器官。

detail.en:
The skeleton supports the body, protects organs and provides attachment for muscles. This merged mesh supplies spatial context; individual bone names are outside this topic’s main line. [S2].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
骨骼支撑身体、保护器官，也供肌肉附着。合并的骨网格提供位置参照；个别骨骼名称不在本主题主线内。 [S2]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Marks the outside of the reference body.
summary.zh: 标出参考身体的外形。

detail.en:
A simplified outside surface locates the systems inside the same male reference body. It is a context layer, not a diagram of the layers of skin. [S1,S11,S12].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
简化的外表面说明各系统位于同一个男性参考身体内。这是参照层，不是皮肤分层图。 [S1,S11,S12]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Provides a lighter reference body surface.
summary.zh: 提供更简化的身体参照表面。

detail.en:
A lower-detail version of the source outside surface. It is hidden with the overlapping outline in chapter views unless explicitly selected as a context layer; neither surface is an organ. [S1,S11,S12].

Mesh selection and simplification: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D. The reference anatomy varies from person to person [S1, S11, S12].
detail.zh:
这是源外表面的低细节版本。章节中将重叠的表面藏起，仅作身体参照；两个表面都不是器官。 [S1,S11,S12]。

网格选取、简化自 Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D；不同人的解剖形态有所差异 [S1, S11, S12]。

summary.en: Shows enamel, dentine and soft pulp in section.
summary.zh: 剖开显示牙釉质、牙本质和牙髓。

detail.en: A schematic molar enlarged sixfold. The pale outer crown is enamel, the layer beneath is dentine, and the central cavity contains soft pulp, blood vessels and nerves. The thin dark lines entering the roots stand for these supplies; they are not mesh-derived anatomy. [S4, S1].
detail.zh: 示意磨牙放大六倍。牙冠外层是浅色牙釉质，下面是牙本质，中央的腔内为柔软的牙髓，含血管和神经。进入牙根的深色细线代表这些组织，并非从网格提取。 [S4, S1]。

summary.en: Shows folds and differently directed muscle layers.
summary.zh: 显示褶皱和不同方向的肌肉层。

detail.en: A schematic wall block enlarged tenfold. Its folded inner lining faces upwards. Strips beneath represent three muscle layers running in different directions; muscle contraction mixes the food. The block is separate from the real stomach mesh. [S5, S1].
detail.zh: 示意胃壁放大十倍。有褶皱的内壁朝上，下面的条纹代表三个走向不同的肌肉层；肌肉收缩使食物混合。标本与真实胃网格分开放置。 [S5, S1]。

summary.en: Shows the folded surface and blood supply.
summary.zh: 显示增大的表面积和内部血管。

detail.en: A schematic patch enlarged one hundredfold. Finger-like villi increase the inside surface of the small intestine. The separate cut-open finger shows a blood-capillary loop and a central lymph vessel. Many simple nutrients enter blood; most absorbed fats first enter lymph, an extension beyond the primary syllabus. [S6,S8, S1].
detail.zh: 示意标本放大一百倍。指状绒毛增大小肠内表面积。旁边剖开的绒毛显示毛细血管环和中央淋巴管。许多简单营养物质进入血液；大部分吸收的脂肪先进入淋巴，这一点属于课纲以外的延伸。 [S6,S8, S1]。

summary.en: Increases the surface available for absorption.
summary.zh: 增大可进行吸收的表面积。

detail.en: Finger-like villi cover the lining of the small intestine. This regular array is a schematic layout enlarged one hundredfold; real villi vary in size and spacing [S1, S6, S8].
detail.zh: 指状绒毛覆盖小肠内壁。规则排列是放大一百倍的示意，真实绒毛的大小与间距并不完全相同 [S1, S6, S8]。
